title: God's speech is spiritual and must be understood according to the speaker's power
english: The Lord spoke to Moses (Leviticus 4:1). The Lord is spirit (John 4:24). The word of God must be understood not according to incapable people, but according to the power of the one speaking.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is beginning a new section of the homily, introducing a quotation from Leviticus where the Lord speaks to Moses, and immediately explaining how divine speech must be understood.

title: Sin against a neighbor and the altar of faith
english: If a soul sins and lies to a neighbor about a deposit or a partnership, it is a transgression (Leviticus 5:21 (6:2)). Faith between brothers is an altar. Lying strips away communion.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is explaining the spiritual meaning of Leviticus 4:1, applying the law of sin against a neighbor to the moral life of believers.

title: Violence and fraud defile the one altar
english: Or if someone has taken by force or made a false accusation. Robbery and fraud defile one and the same altar. Be converted, you who oppress.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying Leviticus 5:21 (6:2) to the soul, explaining that violence and fraud both defile the same altar of faith between brothers.

title: Finding and denying a lost thing
english: Or he finds something lost and denies it. Finding without confession is spiritual theft. Truth restores it.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the Levitical rules about fraud and false dealing to the soul, explaining that finding a lost item and denying it is a spiritual theft.

title: False Oath Usurps God's Name
english: He has sworn falsely. A lying oath usurps the name of God. Let there be fear of an oath.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is listing sins that require confession and restitution, now turning to the sin of swearing falsely.

title: Restitution with a fifth added
english: He will restore the whole and add a fifth part (Leviticus 6:5). Penitence with restitution. Weeping without work is not enough.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the law of restitution for fraud or false oath to the penitent's duty to make amends.

title: The ram as Christ bearing our sin
english: He will offer an unblemished ram to the priest (Leviticus 6:6). Christ is the ram; he bears our sin. The priest assesses it.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is interpreting the Levitical guilt offering, showing that the ram offered to the priest is a figure of Christ bearing our sin.

title: Confession must not be delayed
english: On the day he is convicted, he shall repay. Delaying confession only deepens the wound. Today, if you hear His voice (Psalm 94:7; Hebrew 95:7).
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the ram of the trespass offering to the soul's duty of confession, urging immediate response to God's voice.

title: Two sins, one altar
english: One kind of sin is against the holy things of the Lord, another against the neighbor. Each touches the altar. Love God and the neighbor.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is applying the Levitical sin-offering morally, distinguishing sins against God from sins against neighbor and tying both to the altar.

title: The priest's prayer and Christ as our high priest
english: The priest will pray for him before the Lord, and it will be forgiven to him (Leviticus 4:26). Christ is our high priest. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is explaining the priest's role in atonement, identifying the priest who prays for the sinner with Christ as our high priest.
